sampling_transform: none; one label level per panel; log-scale x axis
caption: Record counts by attack group: N-BaIoT fine classes (family / attack) and Bot-IoT category and subcategory (each panel is a single label level; levels are not added together).
commentary: N-BaIoT malicious traffic is spread over ten Gafgyt and Mirai attack classes, each between 3.6% and 17.4% of the corpus, with benign at 7.9%. Bot-IoT is concentrated in DDoS and DoS (97.5% of records), while Theft has only 79 records and Data_Exfiltration only 6. The binary task merges all attack groups, so these imbalances within the malicious class are not visible in binary metrics.
